purpose: Review a finished edit and name the clips that need a change (Phase E). The model judges; deterministic code applies a closed set of conservative operations and vetoes anything that would break the duration band. It may never name a clip that is not in the list it was shown. Version 2 asked only for clips that need work (version 1 asked for one note per clip and got eleven `keep`s whose prose described trims). Version 3 adds the floor: measured trims of 0.23s were a required field being filled, not a judgement. Version 4 anchors the output language: on a real project the model answered an English prompt with a verdict that drifted into Chinese.

clips.description: Numbered lines: index, position, length, role, what is on screen, what was said, captions and effects.

total.description: Length of the edit as assembled.

intent.description: The viewer's own words, where there are any.
